_comment: DDI-CDI -> CDIF DiscoveryDataDescriptionStructure COMPOSITE profile UML. targetModel.definition: DiscoveryDataDescriptionStructure is the CDIF composite profile that extends DiscoveryDataDescription with full DDI-CDI structural complexity. Assembled from four building-block profile modules: cdifCore + cdifDiscovery + cdifDataDescription + cdifDataStructure. A metadata record validating against this composite must declare conformance to https://w3id.org/cdif/core/1.1, https://w3id.org/cdif/discovery/1.1, https://w3id.org/cdif/data_description/1.1, and https://w3id.org/cdif/data_structure/1.1.
